passages.context: Body paragraphs 1-3 and 7 were read with the complete homily. They follow the ten lepers from their cry and obedient journey to the Samaritan's return, gratitude, praise, and recognition of Jesus as the true Priest, and close by joining Naaman and the Samaritan as foreigners who exemplify faith.
